text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn). Expectations are 
high for Mr. C.B.'s victory upon returning 
from her break.

Symboli Rudolf had also come to witness 
the battle between the two—to see for 
herself if either could stand as a wall 
before her.

Yet all that remains in Katsuragi Ace now 
is the will to keep on fighting. Until the 
day the entire world acknowledges her.

Katsuragi Ace and Mr. C.B. Recognizing 
each other's strength, their unyielding 
Tenno Sho (Autumn) begins...!
